title: CARROT: Competitive Adaptive Graph Clustering via Semi-Relaxed Optimal Transport
abstract: arXiv:2611.34012v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Deep graph clustering (DGC) has emerged as a prominent paradigm for unsupervised attributed graph clustering. However, existing methods often struggle with two practical challenges encountered in real-world applications: the number of clusters $K$ is unknown a priori, and cluster sizes are frequently highly imbalanced. Methods relying on a pre-specified $K$ may fail to recover the underlying clustering structure when $K$ is misspecified, while many approaches implicitly favor balanced partitions, hindering the discovery of minority clusters. We propose CARROT, a Competitive Adaptive gRaph clustering framework via semi-Relaxed Optimal Transport, which introduces semi-relaxed optimal transport into deep graph clustering to jointly address both challenges. CARROT first pre-trains node embeddings to establish a meaningful embedding space, and then jointly optimizes embeddings and cluster assignments through an Adaptive Clustering Mechanism

translated_title: CARROT：基于半松弛最优传输的竞争性自适应图聚类
translated_abstract: 深度图聚类（DGC）已成为无监督属性图聚类的重要范式。然而，现有方法在实际应用中常常面临两个挑战：聚类数量 $K$ 事先未知，且各聚类规模经常高度不平衡。依赖预先指定 $K$ 的方法在 $K$ 设定错误时可能无法恢复潜在的聚类结构，而许多方法隐式地偏好均衡的划分，阻碍了少数聚类的发现。我们提出了CARROT，一种通过半松弛最优传输实现的竞争性自适应图聚类框架，它将半松弛最优传输引入深度图聚类，以联合应对上述两个挑战。CARROT首先预训练节点嵌入以建立一个有意义的嵌入空间，然后通过自适应聚类机制联合优化嵌入和聚类分配。
tldr: 该论文提出CARROT框架，将半松弛最优传输引入深度图聚类，无需预先指定聚类数量即可自适应地确定簇数，并能有效处理簇规模高度不平衡的问题。
en_tdlr: CARROT introduces semi-relaxed optimal transport into deep graph clustering, enabling adaptive determination of the number of clusters without a pre-specified K while effectively handling highly imbalanced cluster sizes.
